blocks.text: Bonfiire is where people find things to do, host their own events and bring everyone together, from a park hangout to an Appro across the city. Students use it the most, but it works just as well for associations, teams, companies and groups of friends.

items: **Host your event.** Create the event page, send the invites and see who's coming.
**E-tickets.** All participants who are attending gets their ticket right in the app.
**Quick check-in.** Scan tickets by using in-built ticket scanner, or find people in the participant list in seconds.
**Bring your group together.** Associations, clubs and groups of friends can plan their events in one place and keep everyone in the loop.

blocks.text: You can host two kinds of events with Bonfiire. The difference is where it happens. It can be in one place, or along a route of multiple checkpoints that participants have to reach as a challenge.

items.title: Single venue event
items.text: Everything happens in one place, like a party, a meetup, a sitsit or an afternoon of board games with friends.

items.title: Multi checkpoints event (Appro)
items.text: A route of checkpoints that groups walk through, participating in games, collecting points and stamps at each stop.

blocks.text: Not sure which one you need? If everyone stays in one place, it's a single venue event. If people move from checkpoint to checkpoint, it's an Appro.

items: **Organizer** creates the event, invites people and runs it.
**Co-host** helps the organizer run the event.
**Checkpoint host** looks after one checkpoint of an Appro, checking groups in and giving points.
**Participant** joins the event, checks in and takes part.

blocks.text: Account creation in bonfiire is simple and only takes 1-2 minutes to complete. You will need a proper email address where we can send you passcode, and entering few profile details, you are good to go.

items: First Name
Last Name
Email address
Date of birth
Gender
Profile picture (optional)
Bio (optional)

sections.title: Steps to sign up your account

blocks.videoHint: Creating an account, from Let's get started to the bio

items.text: Open Bonfiire and press **Let's get started**.
Press **Continue with Email**.
Type in your **Email address** and press **Continue**.
We will send you **6 digits passcode** to your email. Wait for it to arrive, type it into the app and press **Confirm**.
items.note: Please check spam folder, if you don't see email in your inbox.

items.text: Enter your **First Name** and **Last Name** and then press **Next** to continue.
Enter your **Date of birth** and **Press Next**
items.note: You must be 18 or older to use Bonfiire.

items.text: Select your **Gender** and press **Next**
Choose a **picture** for your profile and press **Next**, or skip this for now.
Fill up the **bio** to tell people a little about yourself, or leave it empty. Then press **Done** and you're in.

blocks.text: Your email address is how you get into your Bonfiire account. It's the only login method linked to your account, so there's no password to remember. Just like when you signed up, we send a passcode to your email, and once you're verified you're back in your account.

items: The email address you created your account with

blocks.videoHint: Logging in, from Let's get started to your account

items.text: Open Bonfiire and press **Let's get started**.
Press **Continue with Email**.
Type in the **email address** of your account and press **Continue**.
items.note: If this email isn't linked to a Bonfiire account, the app takes you to sign up instead.

items.text: We will send a **6 digit passcode** to your email. Wait for it to arrive, type it into the app and press **Confirm**. You're in.
items.note: Please check your spam folder if you don't see the email in your inbox.

blocks.text: No account yet? See [Create a new account](account/create-your-profile) to sign up for Bonfiire.
You can update your profile info whenever you like, right in the app. You need to be [logged into your account](account/log-in) to do it.

items: Name
Bio
Date of birth
Gender

blocks.videoHint: Updating your profile, from the Profile tab to Update

items.text: Go to your **Profile**. It's the last tab at the bottom of your screen, with your picture on it.
Press **Edit profile**, right below your picture.
Select the info you want to update and make your changes.
Press **Update** to save your changes. You're done.
items.note: Every change you make is recorded in your activity history, so you can always see what was changed, when, and from where.

blocks.text: To see your profile changes, go to your **Profile**, press the **gear icon** and open **Activity center**.
Your email address is how you log into Bonfiire, and you can change it whenever you need to. You need to be [logged into your account](account/log-in) to do it.

items: The new email address, and access to its inbox to get the passcode

blocks.videoHint: Changing the account email, from the Profile tab to the new passcode

items.text: Go to your **Profile** and press the **gear icon**.
Press **Account**.
You'll see the **email address** your account is linked to. Press it to open the email change screen.
Enter your new **email address**.
We will send a **6 digit passcode** to your new email. Type it into the app to verify it, and your email is changed.
items.note: From now on, your account is linked to your new email address. Use it the next time you log in.

blocks.text: You can ask for a copy of the personal data we have about you. It includes your profile information, the events you have created or joined, and your chat messages. You request it in the app, and once it's ready you download it from the same place.

blocks.videoHint: Requesting a copy of your data, from the Profile tab to Request for data copy

items.text: Go to your **Profile** and press the **gear icon**.
Press **Account**.
Under **Account data and control**, press **Manage your data**.
Press **Request for data copy**. Your request is sent to us.
items.note: It takes 1 to 4 days to get your data ready. We send you an email when it's ready to download.

items.text: Once you get our email, go back to **Manage your data** (your **Profile**, the **gear icon**, then **Account**).
Download the copy of your data.
items.note: Your copy can be downloaded for 7 days. After that it expires, and you need to request a new copy.

blocks.text: Under GDPR and our [privacy policy](/privacy-policy), you can ask us to delete your account at any time. When you do, we delete your account and your personal data from the Bonfiire database.

Your account isn't deleted straight away. It first goes into a 30 day grace period, starting from the day you ask to delete it. If you change your mind, you can reactivate your account any time during those 30 days. Once the grace period ends, your account is permanently deleted and can't be brought back.

blocks.videoHint: Deleting the account, from the Profile tab to Delete account

items.text: Go to your **Profile** and press the **gear icon**.
Press **Account**.
Under **Account data and control**, press **Delete account**.
Tick the box to confirm that you want to delete your account, then press **Delete account**.
items.note: Your 30 day grace period starts now. You can reactivate your account until it ends.

blocks.text: A multi-checkpoint event, or Appro, is a route of checkpoints that groups walk through. At each stop they play a game, collect points and get a stamp.

items: **Checkpoints.** Every Appro has its own route, checkpoints and games.

**Points and leaderboard.** Scores add up as the day goes, and everyone can see the standings.

blocks.text: If the scanner doesn't read a ticket, try these quick fixes first.

items: Turn the participant's screen brightness up.
Make sure the ticket is open in the app, for the right event.
Hold the phone steady, with the whole QR code inside the frame.
Check that the scanner has permission to use the camera.
